capabilities: Julia model interface, tools, solvers and simulators
limitation: Solver ecosystem versions/licenses must be pinned separately
inspection: Primary README/license/package or repository metadata; selected API source where saved. No runtime package benchmark.
pin_limit: Content hashes pin actual saved artifacts. Retrieved HEAD, if present, is a separate observation; mutable-branch files are not asserted to belong to that commit.

scientific_qualification.role: Julia POMDP interface and solver comparator
scientific_qualification.input: State/action/observation spaces, initial law, transition, observation, reward and discount through the model interface.
scientific_qualification.output: Solver-specific policy and model-conditional simulated/belief trajectories.
scientific_qualification.assumptions: Controlled causal model and information filtration are already justified; solver approximations/guarantees depend on the separately chosen package.
scientific_qualification.adapter_rule: Pin POMDPs.jl, POMDPTools, the solver and language bridge independently. The core interface does not itself implement all listed solvers. Keep pre/post-transition observation conventions explicit.
scientific_qualification.acceptance_test: Use the same finite model across the project oracle and a pinned Julia solver; check observation indexing, discount timing and belief measurability.

evidence.finding: Core interface, separate tools/solvers, Tiger transition-observation-reward example.
